OFFER LETTER

Dear Candidate,

We are happy to offer you employment with Quickstart Logistics Private Limited.

Your annual CTC will be Rs. 3,60,000. You will receive a joining bonus of Rs. 25,000, which must be repaid in full if you leave within six months of joining.

Please report on 1 December 2026 with a copy of your identity proof.

The Company reserves the right to modify these terms and its policies from time to time without prior notice.

We look forward to having you on the team.

For Quickstart Logistics Private Limited
Human Resources
